Correction to carry-d15-sav-volume-2 (D15 triage, 2026-10-24; derived ratios only). Withdrawn: "an idle row writes no mode, so the DHW mode keeps the pump charging through plan-idle steps". The owner's integration also owns the supply switch, and the ledger statistic it rested on, 7 of 8 idle steps after a DHW slot ran, is not evidence that the pump ran outside a planned slot. Three seams. (1) The ledger freezes `planned` at the step's first one-minute tick (`_observe`, custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py:1006-1010). That is the plan from before the mid-step re-solve, and the re-solve can move a DHW slot onto the current step. In the bundle, the 13:00 row reads planned dhw while the 13:13 solve's action for that same step is space 0.5 kW and dhw 0. `ran` is real metered pump draw of at least `on_threshold_kw` (0.25 kW) on any one-minute pass (pump_arbiter.py:1013-1015). `dhw` is the mode flag or a tank rise (pump_arbiter.py:1020-1026). (2) The arbiter never writes the switch (pump_arbiter.py:46). The switch is written once per coordinator cycle, from the new plan's step 0 (`_apply_action`, coordinator.py:7581-7595, after the solve at :5634). Cycles run every 15.39 min (median of 641) against 15-minute steps, at a phase spread uniformly through the step (quartiles 4.3, 8.2 and 11.4 min). So each switch-on lasts into the next step, and a slot written late in its own step starts the compressor in the following one: 3 of 4 planned DHW slots show no run in-slot. (3) Checked and refuted: the solve's switch schedule disagreeing with its ask. 0 of 672 published steps were switched on without an ask, or off with one. The bundle holds no switch-state history, so "switch commanded off while draw continued" can be neither confirmed nor ruled out. Owed: score each ledger step against the plan in force when the step's actuation happened (re-freeze `planned` at each cycle's adoption), and actuate the switch at step boundaries, from the arbiter's one-minute tick, rather than at the cycle phase. Controls: a synthetic install with the cycle phase at 0 and at 14 min books identical duty verdicts; a step whose plan changed mid-step is scored against the plan that actuated it; one mutant per seam. The card-equality acceptance from carry-d15-sav-volume-2 stands. [implemented: 5d4e0bcfb]
